operator_io_quirks: institution_grads has 1.3M rows > max_rows_per_table 300000: read_schema must rowid-sample (rowid % k = 0) but original_sizes must still be full count(*) = 1302102.

state_sector_details has composite PK (stateid, level, control) and is the only table with a real PK besides institution_details.unitid; institution_grads and state_sector_grads have NO primary key (pk=[]).

FK state_sector_grads.state -> institution_details.state and state_sector_details.state -> institution_details.state point to a NON-UNIQUE parent column (state has 51 distinct over 3798 rows). fill_foreign_keys_consistently draws with replacement from parent values, so duplicates are fine, but the parent column is not a key.
FK state_sector_grads.stateid -> state_sector_details.stateid points to a column that is only part of a composite PK (not unique alone: 52 distinct stateid over 312 rows).
state_sector_details.stateid has a sample value '0' and state='United States' — a sentinel/aggregate row, not a real state; FK from state_sector_grads.stateid=0 may or may not exist.

Many TEXT columns store numeric-looking values ('823','1146','2010','14.7','99.7|07') and the literal 'NULL' as a string (hbcu, flagship, med_sat_value, endow_value, nicknames, vsa_* columns). Storage class is text, declared TEXT, but values are numeric strings or the literal 'NULL'.
counted_pct and similar store pipe-encoded composites ('99.7|07'); 'similar' stores pipe-joined unitid lists ('232937|100724|...'). String fuzzer will treat these as ordinary strings.
vsa_year is TEXT storing '2010','2011' etc. — text-stored years, not INTEGER; ts_fuzzer dispatches to String (declared TEXT), so no Date/Number year handling.
institution_details has 60 columns, many vsa_* TEXT columns with high null_rate (0.087 for grad_100_value, cohort_size, etc.) and literal 'NULL' strings mixed with real NULLs.
No NOT NULL constraints anywhere (notnull=0 on every column); no CHECK constraints; no UNIQUE indexes reported. So TS's constraint-skip path rarely fires here.
Table names are all lowercase snake_case, no spaces or mixed case; column names likewise. Quoting still required by spec but no case-folding hazard.
institution_grads.unitid has 3704 distinct over 1.3M rows (FK to 3798-row parent) — heavy many-to-one; TS drawing with replacement from parent's 3798 values will produce plausible FK distribution.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on unitid (INTEGER, single-col PK): max_l0=inf, so fresh draws never capped; range [-10^0,10^0]=[-1,1] then int perturb +-1/+-2 — will produce tiny integers (0,1,2,-1) far from real 6-digit unitids. Likely FN on unitid filters/joins.
Number fuzzer on year (INTEGER, no scale args): range [-1,1], perturbed — will NOT produce 2011/2012/2013. Queries filtering year=2011 will match nothing -> FN.

Number fuzzer on REAL columns (long_x, lat_y, awards_per_*): scale=0 default -> range [-1,1], perturbed by +-0.01/+-0.02. Real long_x ~ -86, lat_y ~ 34 — implausible values, FN on geographic/range predicates.

String fuzzer on state/level/control/gender/race/cohort: fresh random strings over a-zA-Z0-9() plus contamination, mixed with 5 sampled originals and literal-pool values. Enum-like columns get garbage -> FN on state='Alabama' style equality unless literal pool supplies it.

String fuzzer on med_sat_value, endow_value, vsa_* (TEXT storing numbers): produces random alnum strings, not numeric strings; comparisons like med_sat_value > 1000 will behave oddly (text vs number affinity) -> FN/FP.
String fuzzer on 'similar' and 'counted_pct' (pipe-encoded): random strings, no pipe structure; LIKE '%|%' predicates may spuriously match or miss.

Literal 'NULL' stored as text in hbcu/flagship/med_sat_value/endow_value/nicknames: String fuzzer treats it as an ordinary element and may emit it; queries testing IS NULL vs ='NULL' will diverge from original semantics.

FK fill: state_sector_grads.state drawn from institution_details.state (51 values) with replacement — plausible; state_sector_grads.stateid drawn from state_sector_details.stateid (52 values incl 0) — plausible. FK consistency likely OK, so FK-join queries may still produce rows.

institution_grads has no PK: sample_fresh_primary_keys is a no-op (empty PK tuple), so duplicate rows survive; drop_unique_duplicates also no-op (no unique cols). Large duplicate multiplicities possible -> FP on COUNT/DISTINCT queries.

state_sector_details composite PK (stateid,level,control): sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate tuples; but level/control are String-fuzzed so PK tuples are mostly unique random strings -> few drops, but stateid/level/control combos implausible.

choose_table_sizes: institution_grads (1.3M original) will be regenerated at ~30-2500 rows, not 1.3M — cardinality mismatch drives FN on aggregate/ratio queries and FP on joins that expect many-to-one fan-out.
Date/Time/Bool/Bit fuzzers not dispatched here (no date/timestamp/bool/bit declared types); all TEXT/INTEGER/REAL. So no template-format quirks, but also no year-as-date handling.
